description: Grade a domain's email authentication from DNS -- the tool to reach for when mail is landing in spam, or someone asks whether a domain is protected against spoofing. Checks MX (can it receive mail), SPF (who may send as it, and whether '+all' lets anyone), DMARC policy (none / quarantine / reject) and DKIM under the common selectors. Returns a 0-100 score, a letter grade, the records found and a prioritised issue list. Up to 4 domains per call. Paid: $0.01 per call in USDC on Base via x402 -- call once without x_payment to receive the payment challenge.

dkimSelectors.description: DKIM selectors to try (max 7; sensible defaults)

x_payment.description: Optional X-PAYMENT header value from a completed x402 payment. Omit on first call to receive the payment challenge; complete the payment with your x402 wallet tooling, then retry with this set.

name: check_email_dns
